storyFa: بنفشِ جوان با دوست سبزِ مسن دوچرخهٔ پنچر را آماده می‌کند؛ دوچرخه با هر دو چرخ و ساختمان روشن دیده می‌شود. سال‌ها بعد، همان بنفشِ اکنون مسن با دوست مرجانیِ جوان‌تر در مسیری متفاوت کنار رودخانه برای گردش تازه همراه می‌شود.
meaningFa: دوست مسن تجربهٔ حل مشکل را با جوان شریک می‌شود؛ دوست جوان در پیری همراه تجربهٔ مسیرهای تازه است.

fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create ONE finished square 1:1 adult-book narrative watercolor illustration about friendship between generations. TWO wide scenes stacked vertically: a young adult shares a bicycle problem with an experienced older friend; decades later the same person, now older, joins a younger friend for a fresh route. Show mutual warmth, shared experience and curiosity through concrete actions, without an explanatory moral caption.

IDENTITY AND AGE
PURPLE is the central SAME person across the two scenes: fixed purple color, medium neutral adult body, perfectly circular head, modest dark oval eyes and a few fine short upper-outer lashes. Upper purple is a YOUNG ADULT without glasses or wrinkles. Lower purple is older, with round glasses, a few fine outer-eye wrinkles and only a slight natural forward shoulder bend, preserving the neutral body and circular head.
Upper friend is an OLDER GREEN adult with round glasses, a few fine eye wrinkles and mild natural shoulder stoop. Lower friend is a YOUNG CORAL adult with short fine upper-outer eyelashes on the same small eye design. All figures are adult-sized, capable, equal friends. Plain colored bodies, no clothing, hats or helmets; elders' simple glasses are the only accessory.

UPPER: SHARED REPAIR IN YOUTH
A sunny park with a wooden bench in the left background, a substantial leafy tree, soft green shrubs, a low stone bank and distant light city buildings. No extra people or repair clutter.
One TURQUOISE BICYCLE stands in the central foreground in a SIMPLE TRUE SIDE VIEW. Rear wheel on LEFT, front wheel on RIGHT. BOTH WHOLE WHEELS are clearly present, coherent and identifiable, with hubs, spokes and full tire outlines; no missing or hidden wheel. The front tire is slightly squashed at its contact with the path to show flatness.
PURPLE crouches at the LEFT, checking/adjusting the chain and rear-wheel area with natural hands, while keeping the rear wheel readable. Both naturally bent legs and complete feet fit within the scene; the crouching pelvis must remain neutral without a separate gendered buttock bulge.
OLDER GREEN stands to the RIGHT, leaning forward only slightly and operating a BLACK FLOOR PUMP with both hands on its horizontal handle. Pump base is on the path to the right of the front wheel. Its flexible hose curves to a visible connector at the FRONT TIRE VALVE, not the wheel axle, bicycle frame or an unrelated cable. Green has a warm reassuring smile and purple a small appreciative smile.
Draw the bicycle mechanically coherently: triangular frame, saddle on seat post, head tube beneath handlebar, fork running to FRONT AXLE, rear stays running to rear hub, bottom bracket and chainring with two opposed crank arms/pedals, chain correctly leading to rear sprocket. Whole handlebar, full bike, pump and hose are contained. Use simple readable parts rather than overloaded technical detail.
A small cream paper-like heading toward the upper-left reads:
"جوانی"
No speech or extra text in this upper scene.

LOWER: A NEW ROUTE WITH A YOUNGER FRIEND
DECADES LATER in a genuinely DIFFERENT SUNNY RIVERSIDE setting: open blue water on the right, a curving pale path, a low wooden safety railing along the bank, soft distant hills and a few small faraway buildings. A different modest tree/foliage can shape the left boundary. No repeated upper park bench, tea glasses, copied city-bank composition or lamppost.
SAME purple now older stands toward the left alongside a complete turquoise bicycle; young CORAL stands toward the right alongside a complete coral bicycle. Both full bodies and feet stay inside the scene. Some lower-leg overlap through the bicycles' open frames is natural, but neither bicycle wheel may disappear behind a body.
Each bicycle is shown in a SIMPLE LEGIBLE mostly side view with only mild three-quarter perspective. Separate the two bicycles enough to distinguish ALL FOUR WHEELS, two coherent frames, saddles, front forks, handlebars, chains and pedals. The left turquoise bicycle has a conventional triangle frame; the coral bicycle can have a coherent lower step-through tube. No fused wheels, disconnected fork, extra tires, impossible chain or clipped bike parts.
Purple holds the handlebar and smiles willingly toward coral, with round glasses, a few fine wrinkles and very slight relaxed old-age shoulder bend. Coral keeps one hand on the own handlebar while extending the other to POINT along the fresh riverside route toward the right. Coral is cheerful and inviting, not pulling or supporting a frail elder.
Heading toward the upper-left:
"سال‌ها بعد"
One white speech bubble, tail clearly pointing to CORAL, reads exactly:
"این مسیر رو امتحان کنیم؟"
The payoff is curiosity and companionship on a fresh route, not the literal reuse of an unchanged park over decades.

Keep the two scenes spacious with a narrow white gutter. All wheels, feet, bicycle components, pump, hose, gestures, lettering and bubbles are fully inside clean white painted-edge breathing space.

STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN
Use authentic moderate hand-painted layered watercolor on luminous textured white paper. Broad softly irregular overlapping translucent washes are visible inside heads, torsos, arms, hands and legs, as well as the scenery, with varied pigment density and subtle local pooling. Colors are warm and clear with restrained soft shading. Preserve a natural painterly finish, not flat/vector coloring, marker, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D, repetitive embossed texture, heavy mottling or decorative splashes.
Every head is a PERFECT CIRCLE with equal width and height, an uninterrupted circular contour, no oval, chin, jaw, flattened lower arc, ears, hair or nose. Head joins shoulders directly WITHOUT A NECK. A soft darker crescent of the same local body hue beneath the head separates it from the upper torso without creating a neck segment.
All bodies have balanced medium adult proportions, neither plump/chibi nor spindly or excessively stretched. All genders use the same simple neutral structure: gently almost-parallel torso sides, natural unshaped pelvis, coherent limbs and naturally aligned legs. No breasts, tiny waist, waist notch, projected hips, separate buttock bulge or gendered contours. Fine short upper-outer eyelashes, where specified, are the principal female cue and must not change the eye design.
Eyes are modest small dark ovals with an optional TINY light glint INSIDE, never white sclera surrounding a pupil or large doll eyes. Simple eyebrows and small expressive mouths. No sharp flat pink circular cheek spots; blush is absent or only barely perceptible diffuse translucent watercolor.
Each openly visible hand has exactly THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural gripping or folded-finger occlusion allowed. Body contours use darker versions of the SAME LOCAL BODY COLOR, not black; facial details and Persian letters may be dark.
Full figures, feet and important objects stay within scene boundaries; natural furniture/boat/prop occlusion is allowed but no body part or object is cut by file or panel edges. Clear irregular watercolor boundaries, generous CLEAN WHITE PAPER outer margins, narrow white gutters, no heavy panel borders. Polished thoughtful adult-book art, warm, kind, quietly witty and family friendly.
All in-image writing is ONLY the short verbatim Persian text specified for that scene, with accurate connected letters and right-to-left direction. No English, extra captions, numbers, watermark or signature. The pictured actions communicate the idea without an explanatory moral caption.
